title: Cross-pillar weekly sync one-pager (prep) - Aria
content:
Purpose: quick alignment between Serving Runtime, Infrastructure, and Console teams ahead of next-week canary. Keep short (30–40m); leave 10m for parking-lot and async follow-ups.

High-level goals this week:
- Verify KV-cache eviction fix stability on canary (low-latency & memory footprint).
- Confirm autoscaler policy change does not regress tail latency under multi-tenant bursts.
- Prioritize small Console UI tweaks that unblock customer debugging flows (token cost breakdown).

Proposed timebox (35 min total):
- 00:00–00:05 — Quick wins & flags (All) — 1-line updates (up/down/degraded)
- 00:05–00:20 — Serving runtime deep-check (Aria + Diego) — KV cache, rollout plan for patch, canary traffic split
- 00:20–00:30 — Infra impact discussion (Hannah) — autoscaler metrics, GPU pool headroom, emergency fallback plan
- 00:30–00:35 — Console priorities (Lina) — telemetry gaps, UX quick fixes, ETA on trace linking
- 00:35–00:40 — Action items + owners + due dates (All)

Talking points / prep notes (for me):
- KV-cache eviction: repro steps from ENG-1209 (see linked_artifacts). Memory spike observed with long-running chats after 8h continuous traffic. Patch PR #412 reduces retention window; need to confirm no throughput drop. Ask Diego for perf numbers at 99th percentile and CPU overhead.
- Canary rollout: plan to move 10% -> 50% over 6 hours if no regressions. Define rollback threshold: +10% 99p latency OR OOM spike. Confirm that console will flag the rollback via alerting hook.
- Autoscaler: Hannah to present a small sim showing pod startup time vs. burst size. We need to decide whether to prefer warm standby (reserved) or aggressive cold-scale with buffer. Cost implications later — call out in notes.
- Console telemetry: missing token-level cost breakdown in traces for dedicated customers (blocking sales). Lina to outline minimal data contract to ship quick UX fix. Also request: link traces to request-id shown in runtime logs.

Action items (format: action — owner — due):
1) Run 6h canary stress run with new eviction patch; capture 50/95/99 latency, memory, CPU — Diego — due 2026-03-12 EOD
2) Prepare rollback triggers and postmortem template for canary (include alert runbook) — Aria — due 2026-03-12 noon
3) Simulate autoscaler with 3 burst profiles; provide recommendation (warm vs cold) + cost delta — Hannah — due 2026-03-13 4pm
4) Console: surface token-cost per request in debug view (minimum MVP) + add dev flag for dedicated tenants — Lina — due 2026-03-16
5) Update canary dashboard to include KV-cache eviction metric and memory heatmap — Jonah — due 2026-03-12 5pm
6) Draft short customer note (ops-facing) describing canary window & potential transient errors — Diego + Lina — due 2026-03-13 11am

Notes to self / quick checklists (scratchy):
- Remind SRE: lower sampling on heavy logs for canary (reduce noise) — slack @sre-rotation.
- Confirm gating on integration tests: long-chat regression tests need to run once before 10% rollout. If flaky, mark as "blocker".
- Parking-lot: how to surface quantization recommendation changes in Optimize UI — defer to product sync.

Open questions (to raise in sync):
- Is +10% 99p latency the right rollback threshold across all models, or should we set per-model baselines? (I suspect per-model)
- Can we safely run canary with 2x token-rate for 30m to expose KV-cache issues faster? Tradeoff = more customer-visible error rate.

After-meeting follow-ups (template to copy into notes):
- Create a follow-up thread with 1-sentence summary + clear owner for each action.
- Attach perf artifacts (grafana links, flamegraphs, heapdumps) to the ticket.
- Convert any product asks to a discrete ticket and tag product-owner.

Parking lot / later items:
- Explore adaptive eviction thresholds per-model class (ML research + infra cost).
- Console: request-level cost breakdown inside customer-facing billing export (medium priority).
- Autoscaler: investigate warm standby autoscaling across regions for lower cold-start.

Quick meeting logistics:
- Proposed meeting time: Friday 09:00 PT (shorten to 35m). If people conflict, push to 09:30.
- Pre-reads: Diego to share perf graph link + Jonah to attach canary dashboard link by Thursday EOD.

Raw scratchy thoughts (do not share):
- If memory leak persists, we should consider a nightly restart for canaries while we debug (ugly but buys time).
- Evaluate whether Optimize can suggest eviction window per workload automatically (longer term).

Revision history: initial draft 2026-03-09, updated with DIego canary numbers and autoscaler ask 2026-03-12.
